newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner says TBS film woes hurt Q3 net.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner says TBS film woes hurt Q3 net.

text.p: Time Warner Inc said in a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing that a pro forma third-quarter net loss is due to disappointing results from Turner Broadcasting System's worldwide movie releases.
Film woes resulted in net writeoffs in TBS's historical data of about $200 million during 1996, Time Warner said in its quarterly filing released late last week.
The figures are based on TBS's financial position and results of operations for the nine months ended Sept 30, having pro forma effect as if it had occured on Sept 30 for balance sheet purposes.
TBS transactions are not reflected in third quarter consolidated financial statements of Time Warner Companies Inc, but will be acounted for in the fourth quarter, the filing said.
